736| def pick_next_node(state: WorkflowState) -> dict[str, Any]:
737|     """Scheduler: decide what to launch, whether to wait, pause or exit.
738| 
739|     Pauses / exits are only taken when nothing is in flight (drain first)."""
740|     plan = state["plan"]
741|     ctx = state["ctx"]
742|     in_flight = ctx.in_flight()
743|     fresh = state["store"].load()
744|     if isinstance(fresh, dict) and fresh.get("cancel_requested"):
745|         plan["cancel_requested"] = True
746|     if plan.get("cancel_requested"):
747|         ctx.cancel.set("用户取消")
748|         return {"route": "wait", "launch": []} if in_flight else {"route": "cancel"}
